properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
Full and empty failures preserve data.
Accepted edges update the ordered logical queue exactly once.
Count remains within the actual caller capacity.
Held levels do not perform another operation.
Prevents spurious overwriting of caller item when not popping.

atomic_propositions.pop_empty: NOT reset AND rising(dequeue) AND pre-count=0
atomic_propositions.push_full: NOT reset AND rising(enqueue) AND pre-count=capacity
atomic_propositions.same: logical queue equals pre-queue AND item equals sampled item
atomic_propositions.push: NOT reset AND rising(enqueue) AND pre-count<capacity
atomic_propositions.pushed: post-queue=pre-queue appended with sampled item AND count=pre-count+1 AND status=0 AND item equals sampled item
atomic_propositions.pop: NOT reset AND rising(dequeue) AND pre-count>0
atomic_propositions.popped: item=pre-front AND post-queue=pre-queue without front AND count=pre-count-1 AND status=0
atomic_propositions.idle: NOT reset AND no request rising edge
atomic_propositions.elementCount: O[k].elementCount: independently observed post-scan candidate value (DINT); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.status: O[k].status: independently observed post-scan candidate value (WORD); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.item: O[k].item: independently observed post-scan candidate value (VARIANT); never defined as expected output. I[k].item denotes separately captured caller value before invocation.
atomic_propositions.buffer: O[k].buffer: independently observed post-scan candidate value (VARIANT); never defined as expected output. I[k].buffer denotes separately captured caller value before invocation.
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.elementCount=0, O_init.status=0.
